name: SimpleTexting
summary: SMS marketing and business texting: run mass-text campaigns, two-way conversations and automations with compliance built in.
best_for: US businesses that want straightforward, compliant SMS marketing and two-way texting with rollover credits
skip_if: you don't have a real opted-in list or a compelling offer — texting a cold audience burns money and trust
honest_knock: The credit model plus US carrier (10DLC) fees and per-number/per-seat add-ons mean the sticker isn't the whole bill — and SMS marketing only works with genuine opt-in and a real offer, not blasting a cold list.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-03 on simpletexting.com/pricing) Credit-based by monthly volume, and the headline is not the plan price: the page's "estimated monthly cost" bundles a $10/mo local number into every figure. The credit plans themselves are $29 (500 credits), $49 (1,000), $79 (2,000), $109 (3,000), $229 (7,500), $399 (15,000), $549 (25,000) and $899 (50,000) a month, so the printed $39 to $909 range is those figures plus the number. SMS = 1 credit, an extended message up to 306 characters = 2, MMS = 3; incoming SMS is free and incoming MMS costs 1 credit. Extra credits beyond the plan taper with the tier, from 5.5 cents at 500 to 2 cents at 50,000. Yearly billing takes 20% off the credit portion only — the entry tier becomes $23.20 of credits plus the same $10 number, i.e. $33.20 a month billed yearly at $398.40 — and grants the year's credits as one upfront bucket (6,000 at the entry tier) instead of a monthly allowance. The rollover rule the page states is for monthly plans: unused plan credits roll over until the end of the following month. Every paid plan includes three user seats, with additional seats at $20/mo and additional numbers at $10/mo; a local number carries a $4 activation fee and there is a separate one-off $4 carrier (10DLC) registration. A toll-free number has no additional monthly fee but carrier approval can take up to a week; dedicated short codes begin at $1,000/mo and take 6-8 weeks to provision. Carrier fees are passed through without markup at roughly $0.0025 per message in the US and $0.0068 in Canada. Nonprofits, churches and other tax-exempt organisations get 15% off any monthly plan, and there is a 30-day refund.
